rationale: Price is at 93.2% of today's range and within 0.57% of the session high after a 3.57% gap-up, with the last 5 candles showing a brief dip and recovery — momentum is ambiguous at an extended level. Entering long near the high with a pending legal overhang and entering short against strong market momentum both present unfavorable risk/reward; skipping preserves capital.
